name: Bright Angel Trail to Plateau Point
why: The old Havasupai path down through every layer of rock to the oasis of Havasupai Gardens and out to a point above the Colorado River.
book: No permit for a day hike. Trailhead by the Bright Angel Lodge, Village shuttle (blue). The park advises against going past Havasupai Gardens in one day in summer.
water: Seasonal drinking water at the 1.5 and 3 mile rest houses and Havasupai Gardens (often off because of pipeline breaks: carry 4 litres).
dangers: Heat: rangers rescue hundreds of day hikers each year; the inner canyon passes 40°C.
The climb out is 939 m: plan twice the time of the way down.
Ice on the top switchbacks in winter: microspikes.
turnaround: Leave Havasupai Gardens for the rim by 12:00.

points.name: Bright Angel trailhead
points.note: Next to the Kolb Studio at the rim.

points.name: Havasupai Gardens
points.note: Cottonwoods and a creek on the Tonto Plateau, with a campground and a ranger station.

points.name: Plateau Point
points.note: A point on the Tonto Plateau 400 m above the Colorado River.
